Green at c5399a422 with the database attached. Two failures were resolved on the way, and the second was a real regression this task introduced rather than a flake.

(1) async-command-sandbox-runner.test.ts 'kills a direct command process group on timeout' failed once under full-suite load and passed 6/6 across three isolated runs on the identical commit — load-correlated, outside this task's write scope, same class as deferral D-0085, not touched here.

(2) inline-agent-runtime.integration.test.ts 'runs mocked Claude and OpenAI-compatible inline turns...' failed DETERMINISTICALLY on T2's code and passed at the stage baseline. The test mocks @core/runtime/agent-spawn-host.js with a vi.mock FACTORY, which replaces the module wholesale; T2 added getConfiguredProviderSessionMaxInputTokens there (the accessor seam the approved plan prescribes) and the factory did not export it, so the call threw a TypeError inside the awaited preflight and the run never left status 'running'. Fixed by completing the mock — no assertion or timeout was altered. It was invisible to every earlier verify because that lane skips without GANTRY_TEST_DATABASE_URL.

reviewed_scope: cache-bug-T2: the limits.provider_session_max_input_tokens setting through the parser, types, defaults, revision document, fleet import (reader version 15 -> 16) and the canonical YAML renderer, which previously dropped a scalar-only cap; the ceiling preflight in group-agent-runner.ts placed after prepareCompactionDeltaReplay and the access-fingerprint check; the POST-RUN mark raise, once per turn after invokeAgent settles rather than per streamed output; the overflow clamp normalised at the integer column's limit in the domain and consumed inside raiseProviderSessionContextHighWaterMark so no caller can bypass it; the lost-fence recovery shared between the ceiling and fingerprint paths and parameterised on restoreResumeIdentifiers, since decision 0158 makes a fingerprint-invalid session never resumable while a lost ceiling fence may resume from the re-read; session.provider.retired with a reason-discriminated payload and session.provider.cleanup_failed as a separate flat payload, published best-effort for ceiling, fingerprint and missing-session; the retired-reference sink on runAgent's options for T3 to drain; and the operator procedures whose observability SQL a Postgres test extracts from the document and executes against the live schema.
